item.title: CISA adds Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS SAML authentication bypass CVE-2026-129004 to Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
item.description:
Federal cybersecurity authorities have updated Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog directives under Binding Operational Directive 22-01, issuing an emergency remediation mandate for an actively weaponized perimeter firewall flaw. Remote unauthenticated threat actors exploit single sign-on assertion parsing logic to gain administrative access across GlobalProtect edge gateways.
The emergency security directive covers Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS software vulnerability CVE-2026-129004 carrying a CVSS score of 9.8. Remote unauthenticated threat actors send malformed SAML authentication tokens containing forged identity signatures to bypass multi-factor authentication handlers on PAN-OS 11.2, 11.1, and 10.2 releases. Successful exploitation grants unauthenticated remote adversaries administrative access to firewall management portals and GlobalProtect SSL VPN gateways without valid user credentials. CISA set a mandatory December 13 compliance deadline for Federal Civilian Executive Branch agencies to deploy updated firmware releases.
Subverting perimeter firewall controllers and secure remote access gateways destroys network perimeter boundaries and internal subnet isolation. Because PAN-OS firewalls manage corporate SSL VPN access and site-to-site IPsec tunnels, an unauthenticated SAML authentication bypass permits threat actors to hijack user sessions, inspect encrypted traffic streams, and move laterally across production subnets.
- Upgrade PAN-OS software installations immediately across firewalls and Panorama appliances to emergency maintenance releases. - Restrict public internet access to administrative web management portals, placing management interfaces on isolated out-of-band VLANs. - Audit SAML identity provider configuration logs for anomalous authentication assertions originating from unverified IP address ranges. - Invalidate active GlobalProtect remote access user session tokens and execute mandatory credential rotations across corporate VPN user accounts.
Perimeter gateway security demands rapid software update deployment and strict out-of-band management isolation to ensure corporate firewall infrastructure remains protected against unauthenticated authentication bypass exploits. #CodeDefence #PaloAltoNetworks #PANOS #GlobalProtect #SAML #AuthBypass #SSLVPN #PerimeterSecurity #CISA #KEV #AppSec #PatchManagement

item.title: Active zero day exploitation targets Ivanti Connect Secure SAML single sign on bypass flaw CVE-2026-128501
item.description:
Enterprise secure remote access advisories published today warn of accelerated wild attack campaigns targeting perimeter gateway appliances. Unauthenticated remote threat actors exploit single sign-on logic flaws within SAML parsing subroutines to obtain administrative remote execution on edge access gateways.
The emergency security bulletin addresses Ivanti Connect Secure ICS and Policy Secure IPS vulnerability CVE-2026-128501 carrying a CVSS score of 9.9. Unauthenticated remote threat actors transmit malformed SAML authentication requests to public web endpoints, bypassing authentication checks and triggering downstream command injection routines under root privileges. Threat research writeups confirm nation-state threat actors actively weaponize the zero-day to drop persistent web shell backdoors and harvest corporate SSL VPN session tokens. Ivanti distributed emergency out-of-band patches to mitigate active intrusion campaigns.
Subverting central remote access controllers undermines perimeter security boundaries and corporate identity governance. Because Ivanti Connect Secure manages corporate VPN connections and zero-trust edge access, an unauthenticated root compromise permits threat actors to intercept internal network transit traffic, extract user credentials, and pivot across internal subnets.
- Apply official Ivanti out-of-band security updates immediately across all deployed Connect Secure and Policy Secure gateway appliances. - Run the official Integrity Checker Tool ICT to inspect system file structures for unauthorized web shell modifications or backdoor scripts. - Restrict public internet access to administrative web portals, routing management interfaces through out-of-band VLANs. - Invalidate active remote access user session tokens and reset corporate user authentication credentials across managed gateway nodes.
Secure access gateway defense requires emergency patch application and rigorous file integrity monitoring to ensure perimeter remote connections remain protected against unauthenticated command execution exploits. #CodeDefence #Ivanti #ConnectSecure #PolicySecure #ZeroDay #RCE #SAML #CommandInjection #PerimeterSecurity #AppSec #PatchManagement #CISA

item.title: Cisco releases security updates for Expressway Series unauthenticated command execution vulnerability CVE-2026-76466
item.description:
Perimeter collaboration security alerts published today detail out-of-band security maintenance releases targeting edge gateway systems. Platform maintainers fixed input sanitization errors across management API endpoints to block unauthenticated remote code execution.
The security patch resolves Cisco Expressway Series vulnerability CVE-2026-76466 carrying a CVSS score of 9.6. Unauthenticated remote adversaries transmit crafted HTTP POST requests to web management portals, exploiting improper input validation logic to execute system commands under elevated privileges. Threat telemetry tracks automated scanning scripts actively targeting exposed Expressway gateway clusters globally. Cisco mandated immediate upgrading to maintenance software build X15.5.20 to protect enterprise collaboration networks.
Subverting edge collaboration gateways compromises enterprise communication privacy and perimeter access controls. Because Cisco Expressway manages external SIP call signaling, video conference traversal, and mobile access, an unauthenticated gateway takeover allows threat actors to eavesdrop on corporate calls, deploy persistent implants, and pivot into internal network segments.
- Upgrade Cisco Expressway Series gateway appliances immediately to patched software build X15.5.20. - Restrict public internet exposure of administrative web management portals, placing management portals behind out-of-band VLANs. - Inspect system process trees and network egress logs on Expressway nodes for unverified shell spawns or unexpected connections. - Invalidate active administrative session tokens and enforce credential rotations across managed collaboration gateway nodes.
Edge collaboration security demands immediate software updates and strict out-of-band management proxying to ensure collaboration gateways remain insulated from unauthenticated remote code execution. #CodeDefence #Cisco #Expressway #CVE202676466 #RCE #PerimeterSecurity #NetworkSecurity #AppSec #PatchManagement #CISA
